# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest commit on `main`. Older commits and personal deployment copies are not maintained as separate supported versions.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ekseh93/kakao-maple-bot/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public Issue for credentials, personal data, authorization bypasses, or other exploitable details.

Include only the minimum sanitized information needed to reproduce the problem:

- affected commit and component
- impact and safe reproduction steps
- whether credentials or personal data may be involved, without pasting their values
- a suggested mitigation, if available

The repository owner will review the report and respond through the private advisory. This personal, non-commercial project does not promise a fixed response SLA or a bug bounty.
